crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An irregular, high-contrast white patch located on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp demarcation separating the black and white patterned head from the uniform gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct colored spots are visible on the gray dorsal surface: one small bright red circular mark and two larger orange-brown patches.
